content_strategy.goal: Move Igor Vepretski's real public archive onto the homepage as a dense visual narrative rather than a buried list of links.
content_strategy.source_capture: Render a new public-page capture when an accessible source page can be represented visually.
content_strategy.video_frame: Use a public video poster frame when it communicates the source more clearly than a page capture.
content_strategy.editorial_reconstruction: When a platform blocks a reliable preview, generate a complete 7YA editorial card from verified metadata and label it explicitly as a reconstruction.
content_strategy.direct_source_requirement: Every visual unit must retain a direct link to its public source.

editorial_boundaries.capture_is_not_original_screenshot: A newly rendered page capture must be labelled SOURCE CAPTURE and must not be described as the original historical screenshot.
editorial_boundaries.reconstruction_disclosure: Every regenerated or metadata-built visual must be labelled EDITORIAL RECONSTRUCTION.
prohibited: presenting regenerated visuals as original evidence
inventing metrics, quotations or source relationships
editorial_boundaries.claims: Metrics remain dated, source-specific and separate; the visual layer does not create a new cumulative reach claim.

acceptance.homepage_position: immediately after Igor's personal chapter and before the historical influence analysis

source_control.note: This receipt preserves the verified runtime behavior and editorial method. It does not claim that the full AppDeploy v52 source snapshot has already been exported into GitHub.

rollback.label: historical digital culture archive before Knowledge Footage
